# docs-host-vault-context

Imported host-vault mirrors, session logs, and research docs.

## Why this matters

Host-machine vault mirror — Claude Code plugin notes, MCP knowledge, session logs. Useful when designing the agent-side tooling (CLI integrations, plugin contracts) because it captures what the user has already evaluated and how.

## What lives here

- `host-vault/AI Knowledge/Claude Code Plugins/` — per-plugin notes (Configuration, MOC, Task Master, Dippy, Lasso claude-hooks, QMD)
- (more under `host-vault/AI Knowledge/` and `host-vault/sessions/` — explore on demand)

## Where it connects

- Adjacent: `docs-vault-wiki`, `docs-host-obsidian-vault`
- Direct input to: `docs-clis-mcps-integrations` (the agent-side CLI/MCP design)

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git ls-tree -r origin/docs-host-vault-context --name-only | grep -i <topic>
```
